    (htrace : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → |trace L J n-exposingWeight n| ≤
      C*(exp (-exp (2*(L-1)))+(1/2:ℝ)^J)/(n:ℝ)^2) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M, (log n+boxConst)*|exposingWeightTrunc N n-trace L J n|) ≤
      exposingTail N+C*(exp (-exp (2*(L-1)))+(1/2:ℝ)^J)*(∑' n,repairDensity n)

private theorem residual_cost {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (L : ℝ) (J N M : ℕ)
    (htrace : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → |trace L J n-exposingWeight n| ≤
      C*(exp (-exp (2*(L-1)))+(1/2:ℝ)^J)/(n:ℝ)^2) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M, (log n+boxConst)*|exposingWeightTrunc N n-trace L J n|) ≤
      exposingTail N+C*(exp (-exp (2*(L-1)))+(1/2:ℝ)^J)*(∑' n,repairDensity n)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let T := C*(exp (-exp (2*(L-1)))+(1/2:ℝ)^J)
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := by dsimp [T]; positivity
  have hb : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M,
      (log n+boxConst)*|exposingWeightTrunc N n-trace L J n| ≤
      (if N<n then exposingMajorant n else 0)+T*repairDensity n := by
    intro n hn
    have hn2 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
    have hl := Real.log_natCast_nonneg n
    have hw : 0 ≤ log n+boxConst := add_nonneg hl boxConst_nonneg
    have he : |exposingWeightTrunc N n-trace L J n| ≤
        (if N<n then |exposingWeight n| else 0)+|trace L J n-exposingWeight n| := by
      by_cases h : n ≤ N
      · simp only [exposingWeightTrunc,if_pos h,if_neg (not_lt.mpr h),zero_add,abs_sub_comm]
        exact le_rfl
      · simp only [exposingWeightTrunc,if_neg h,if_pos (lt_of_not_ge h),zero_sub,abs_neg]
        have ht := abs_add_le (trace L J n-exposingWeight n) (exposingWeight n)
        rw [sub_add_cancel] at ht; linarith
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hw
    have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (htrace n hn2) hw
    have hdom : (log n+boxConst)*(T/(n:ℝ)^2) ≤ T*repairDensity n := by
      dsimp [repairDensity]
      have hinv : 0 ≤ ((n:ℝ)^2)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show log n+boxConst ≤ 2*log n+boxConst by linarith)
        (mul_nonneg hT hinv)
      calc (log n+boxConst)*(T/(n:ℝ)^2) = (T*((n:ℝ)^2)⁻¹)*(log n+boxConst) := by ring
        _ ≤ (T*((n:ℝ)^2)⁻¹)*(2*log n+boxConst) := ht
        _ = T*((2*log n+boxConst)*((n:ℝ)^2)⁻¹) := by ring
    have hhead : (log n+boxConst)*(if N<n then |exposingWeight n| else 0) =
        if N<n then exposingMajorant n else 0 := by
      split_ifs <;> simp [exposingMajorant,hn2]
    dsimp only [T] at hd hdom
    rw [mul_add,hhead] at hmul
    exact hmul.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (hd.trans hdom))
  calc _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M, ((if N<n then exposingMajorant n else 0)+T*repairDensity n) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hb
    _ = (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M,if N<n then exposingMajorant n else 0)+
        T*(∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M,repairDensity n) := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ exposingTail N+T*(∑' n,repairDensity n) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact (summable_exposingTail_terms N).sum_le_tsum _ (fun n _ => by
          split_ifs <;> [exact exposingMajorant_nonneg n; exact le_rfl])
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (repairDensity_summable.sum_le_tsum _
          (fun n _ => repairDensity_nonneg n)) hT

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let C := 2 * (‖ccmArchimedeanRemainderScalar‖ + 46)
  let L := 4 * (‖ccmArchimedeanRemainderScalar‖ + 46) / Real.pi
  let q := Real.exp (-4)
  let K := 2 * Real.log C + 10
  have hC : 2 ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith [norm_nonneg ccmArchimedeanRemainderScalar]
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log C := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  have hq : 0 < q := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by dsimp [q]; exact Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hK : 0 < K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  let M := 1 / (1 - q) + L * C
  let R := 1 + L * C
  refine ⟨M, R, by dsimp [M]; positivity, by dsimp [R]; positivity, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ccmNormalizedWeilRemainder_budget_contraction K q hK hq]
    with a hrec
  intro ha p V hpNorm hpBudget
  let H := ccmNormalizedWeilRemainder ⟨a, ha⟩
  let η := L * V / Real.sqrt (Real.exp (K * a))
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := hpBudget.nonneg
  have hη : 0 ≤ η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
  have hnlo : a ≤ (⌈a⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil a
  have hnhi : (⌈a⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ a + 1 := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one ha.le).le
  have hstep (n : ℕ) : ‖H^[n + 1] p‖ ≤ q * ‖H^[n] p‖ + η * C ^ n := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    convert hrec ha (H^[n] p) (C ^ n * V)
      (source_iterate_budget ⟨a, ha⟩ p hpBudget n) using 1
    all_goals dsimp only [H, η, C, L]
    all_goals ring
  have hb (n : ℕ) : ‖H^[n] p‖ ≤ q ^ n * V + η * C ^ n :=
    recurrence_bound (fun n => ‖H^[n] p‖) (q := q) (C := C) (E := V) (η := η)
      hq.le (by linarith) hη hpNorm
      hstep n
  have hqN : q ^ ⌈a⌉₊ * V ≤ V * Real.exp (-4 * a) := by
    have hqBound : q ^ ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ Real.exp (-4 * a) := by
      dsimp [q]
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqBound hV).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  have hCN : C ^ ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ C * Real.exp (Real.log C * a) := by
    calc
      _ = Real.exp ((⌈a⌉₊ : ℝ) * Real.log C) := by rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hCpos]
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((a + 1) * Real.log C) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
      _ = C * Real.exp (Real.log C * a) := by
        rw [show (a + 1) * Real.log C = Real.log C + Real.log C * a by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hCpos]
  have htailRate : η * C ^ ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ (L * C * V) * Real.exp (-5 * a) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ η * (C * Real.exp (Real.log C * a)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCN hη
      _ = (L * C * V) * Real.exp (-5 * a) := by
        dsimp [η, K]
        rw [sqrt_exp_eq_exp_half, div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg]
        rw [show L * V * Real.exp (-((2 * Real.log C + 10) * a / 2)) *
            (C * Real.exp (Real.log C * a)) = L * C * V *
              (Real.exp (-((2 * Real.log C + 10) * a / 2)) *
                Real.exp (Real.log C * a)) by ring]
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2
        ring
  have htail : η * C ^ ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ L * C * V := by
    have hexp : Real.exp (-5 * a) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    exact htailRate.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity)).trans_eq (mul_one _))
  constructor
  · have htailDecay : η * C ^ ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ L * C * V * Real.exp (-4 * a) :=
      htailRate.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) (by positivity))
    exact (hb _).trans ((add_le_add hqN htailDecay).trans_eq (by dsimp [R]; ring))
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range ⌈a⌉₊, (q ^ j * V + η * C ^ j) := sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hb j)
      _ = (∑ j ∈ range ⌈a⌉₊, q ^ j) * V + η * (∑ j ∈ range ⌈a⌉₊, C ^ j) := by
        rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_mul, mul_sum]
